visualCharacteristics: A recruitment information section with a heading, navigation lists of linked cards with READ MORE labels, a recruitment site description with a policy link, and a large linked image banner.
contentPattern: Rows classified by content: heading [h2]; card rows (repeat) [h3 with en label and em title, or title paragraphs][p > a READ MORE] (cards with a heading form the first nav, cards without one the second); site row [paragraphs, h3, paragraphs, p > a policy PDF]; banner row [PC picture, SP picture][h2 with em sub-copy, p > a link label].
usage: Use it to link to the job categories and the external recruitment site at the end of a recruitment page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it for recruitment entry link lists with a site banner; use cards for generic link card grids.
